id: title:Gilbert09:treat doris fe ssl disabled handshake rejection as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a deterministic, non-retryable classification for Apache Doris FE MySQL SSL disabled errors, preventing unnecessary retry loops when Doris rejects the SSL handshake. This could help warehouse ingestion stability for Doris users.
review.reason: Adds a new non-retryable error entry and a corresponding test for Apache Doris FE MySQL SSL disabled. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and correctness improvement: it updates the error classification dictionary and adds a test assertion. No broader systemic capability or unverified benefit is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: No evidence of actual Doris adoption, incident avoidance, or realized benefit; tier assigned solely on the presence of the code change.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No tier assigned.
